Telangana on Orange Alert for heavy rain, Hyderabad Police advise people to avoid going out
IMD’s district-level nowcast covers Karimnagar, Medak, Rajanna Sircilla, Ranga Reddy, Sangareddy and Siddipet districts
By Newsmeter NetworkRepresentation Image
Hyderabad: The India Meteorological Department (IMD), Hyderabad, on Tuesday issued an orange warning for several districts in Telangana. It forecast moderate rain accompanied by thunderstorms, while Hyderabad Traffic Police advised residents to venture outdoors only if absolutely necessary due to heavy rain and waterlogging.
According to the IMD’s district-level nowcast covers Karimnagar, Medak, Rajanna Sircilla, Ranga Reddy, Sangareddy and Siddipet districts.
The weather office said these districts are likely to experience moderate rainfall and thunderstorms, urging people to remain prepared.
Yellow warning for other districts
A yellow warning has also been issued for Adilabad, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Hanamkonda, Hyderabad, Jagtial, Jangaon, Kamareddy, Khammam, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Mahabubabad, Mahabubnagar, Mancherial, Mulugu, Nagarkurnool, Nalgonda, Narayanpet, Nirmal, Nizamabad, Peddapalli, Suryapet, Vikarabad, Warangal and Yadadri Bhuvanagiri districts, where light to moderate rain and thunderstorms with wind speeds of up to 40 kmph are likely.
Weather radar images showed intense rain-bearing clouds over parts of Hyderabad and its surrounding areas, with intermittent heavy showers reported across the city during the evening.
Traffic advisory
In view of the prevailing weather conditions, Hyderabad Traffic Police issued a public advisory asking citizens to avoid venturing out unless necessary.
The advisory warned that heavy rainfall had led to waterlogging and slow-moving traffic at several locations across the city.
Motorists have been advised to:
- Follow instructions issued by traffic police personnel.
- Authorities have urged residents to remain indoors wherever possible and exercise caution until the weather improves
